novel_claims: IrLoadBool constant tracking completes the constant lattice for all scalar-producing opcodes (IrLoadImm + IrLoadBool). Prior to Block K, boolean conditions from IrLoadBool were opaque to the optimizer, preventing Block F branch folding on boolean-valued registers.
Cross-block chain: IrLoadBool(true) → Block K tracks const → Block F folds BranchTrue to IrJump. First optimizer path that connects boolean IR production to control-flow simplification.
